name: Adrenaline Rush
description: Fueling your passion, one rush at a time.
story: Adrenaline Rush is a burgeoning energy drink brand based in Saudi Arabia, seeking to expand its market presence. They believe motorsport provides an ideal platform to showcase their product's energy-boosting properties and align with a dynamic and competitive environment. They are eager to partner with emerging teams to build brand awareness and drive sales in the region.
